rows.comment: Ends on a 'platform limit, not a setting' antithesis nobody asked for, and uses an em dash. The factual limit stays.
lineComments: Names the real constraint: Apple's fixed event list.
The em dash joins two clauses; use a comma.
'Android gets it' is casual; say Android supports it.
'Not a setting' rebuts a claim no one made.
rows.replacement: "iOS cannot do this. A Shortcuts personal automation only triggers on Apple's own fixed list of events, and apps cannot add to it, so nothing here can start a shortcut. Android supports it."

rows.comment: Technical spec of the intent extras; exact and useful.
lineComments: Names the extras and their types.

rows.comment: Heading for a privacy list; clear.
Privacy statement kept. The 'bare zero' sentence and the em dash are flourish; state what the event carries.
lineComments: The privacy claim; keep it, drop the em dash.
'Absent with a reason' becoming 'a bare zero' is an unverifiable story.
Continues the story; no checkable fact.
Closing aphorism 'facts go out; measurements do not' restates line 1.
rows.replacement: 'The event carries no readiness, strain or sleep score, on either platform. It reports only facts about the sync, such as the record count and time.'

rows.comment: Security rationale is worth keeping. Curly quotes and the hypothetical need tightening.
lineComments: Action name is a literal; keep.
rows.replacement: 'Send wtf.openstrap.openstrap_edge.BUZZ_STRAP with this token as the string extra "token". The token stops other apps on the phone from buzzing your band.'

rows.comment: 'What it cannot do is' is a setup-contrast; split into two plain facts.
lineComments: Useful fact: you can run the shortcut yourself.
'What it cannot do is' builds a contrast.
rows.replacement: 'On iOS, a shortcut you run yourself can reach the app. It cannot start itself when the band syncs.'

lineComments: Vague; state that the briefing failed.

rows.replacement: 'Nothing. The note above was written on this phone, so no request was made.'

rows.comment: Privacy statement of what was sent; states a checkable fact. Leave as is.

lineComments: 'Hand it' and 'it had none' are figurative; say found nothing.

rows.comment: Restates the title 'Every beat against the one before it' in different words.

SD1/SD2 undefined; define as standard deviation.

rows.replacement: 'Points on the diagonal are beats the same length as the one before. SD1, the standard deviation across the diagonal, is beat-to-beat variation. SD2, along the diagonal, is slower drift.'
